title: Esophageal Impedance and Manometry Measurements and Dysphagia Symptom Scoring
brief_summary: Comparison of manometry measurements and EndoFlip Balloon measurements in patients with dysphagia and a known esophageal diagnosis
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients who presented to GI Motility Lab at IU University Hospital for esophageal manometry-impedance and/or EndoFLIP

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \<18 yrs old
* Unable to communicate verbally with the staff
study_population: Study subjects will be recruited from patients who were referred by their physicians to the GI Motility Lab at IU University Hospital for esophageal manometry-impedance and/or EndoFLIP
